description: Source code for plugin management in lighttpd, including plugin initialization, loading, callback registration, and cleanup functions.

methods.name: plugin_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a plugin structure.

methods.name: plugin_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a plugin, including its library handle.

methods.name: plugins_load
methods.description: Loads plugins either statically or dynamically based on configuration.

methods.name: plugins_call_fn_srv_data_all
methods.description: Calls all server-wide plugin callbacks for a specific event.

methods.name: plugins_call_handle_trigger
methods.description: Invokes handle trigger callbacks for plugins.

methods.name: plugins_call_handle_sighup
methods.description: Invokes handle SIGHUP callbacks for plugins.

methods.name: plugins_call_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up plugin resources during server shutdown.

methods.name: plugins_call_init
methods.description: Initializes plugins, registers callbacks, and sets up plugin slots.
